//go:build integration && linux

// Design: docs/architecture/l2tp/bng-5-pppoe.md -- original IPv6 carrier custody
// Related: native_ipv6_fragment_integration_linux_test.go -- five native roots
// Source: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v7.3/net/core/dev.c -- FIFO receive
// Source: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v7.3/drivers/net/veth.c -- no GRO/XDP
// Source: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v7.3/net/ipv6/addrconf.c -- route readiness
package kernel

import (
	"net"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/vishvananda/netlink"
	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

// A pinned injector and zero RPS on every subsequently created device make
// veth __netif_rx and PPP netif_rx share one FIFO CPU backlog. The later useful
// UDP receive acknowledges the earlier fragment's full native receive call.
// Call before newNativeV6Fixture or nativeV6ReplacementNew creates any device.
func nativeV6FragmentOrdering(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	runtime.LockOSThread()
	var original unix.CPUSet
	if err := unix.SchedGetaffinity(0, &original); err != nil {
		runtime.UnlockOSThread()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := unix.SchedSetaffinity(0, &original); err != nil {
			// Keep this thread locked; its changed affinity must not escape
			// into the runtime's pool after restoration failed.
			t.Errorf("restore original injector CPU affinity: %v", err)
			return
		}
		var restored unix.CPUSet
		if err := unix.SchedGetaffinity(0, &restored); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("confirm restored injector CPU affinity: %v", err)
			return
		}
		if restored != original {
			t.Error("injector CPU affinity restoration changed the original mask")
			return
		}
		runtime.UnlockOSThread()
	})
	var single unix.CPUSet
	selected := -1
	for cpu := range int(unsafe.Sizeof(original) * 8) {
		if original.IsSet(cpu) {
			single.Set(cpu)
			selected = cpu
			break
		}
	}
	if selected < 0 {
		t.Fatal("native injector has no permitted CPU")
	}
	if err := unix.SchedSetaffinity(0, &single); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var actual unix.CPUSet
	if err := unix.SchedGetaffinity(0, &actual); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if actual != single {
		t.Fatal("native injector did not retain its exact single-CPU affinity")
	}
	// userns.Enter owns a private network namespace. This sysctl stores
	// net->core.rps_default_mask, not the host's net_hotdata RFS table.
	const path = "/proc/sys/net/core/rps_default_mask"
	previous, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read private network namespace RPS default prerequisite: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, previous, 0); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("restore private network namespace RPS default: %v", err)
		}
	})
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("0"), 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mask, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fields := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(mask)), ",")
	for _, field := range fields {
		value, err := strconv.ParseUint(field, 16, 32)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if value != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("private network namespace retained RPS steering: %q", mask)
		}
	}
}

// The newly created ingress veth must not take veth_xdp_rx/NAPI or an XDP
// redirect. Disabling GRO removes its NAPI allocation when XDP is absent.
func nativeV6FragmentIngress(t *testing.T, route *netlink.Handle, name string) {
	t.Helper()
	link, err := route.LinkByName(name)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if link.Type() != "veth" {
		t.Fatalf("native fragment ingress kind=%q, want owned veth", link.Type())
	}
	if link.Attrs().Xdp != nil {
		if link.Attrs().Xdp.Attached {
			t.Fatal("owned fragment ingress has an XDP program")
		}
		if link.Attrs().Xdp.ProgId != 0 {
			t.Fatal("owned fragment ingress has an XDP program ID")
		}
	}
	fd, err := unix.Socket(unix.AF_INET, unix.SOCK_DGRAM|unix.SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := unix.Close(fd); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	value := struct {
		command uint32
		data    uint32
	}{command: unix.ETHTOOL_SGRO}
	request := struct {
		name    [unix.IFNAMSIZ]byte
		data    unsafe.Pointer
		padding [unsafe.Sizeof(unix.Ifreq{}) - unix.IFNAMSIZ - unix.SizeofPtr]byte
	}{data: unsafe.Pointer(&value)}
	copy(request.name[:], name)
	for _, command := range []uint32{unix.ETHTOOL_SGRO, unix.ETHTOOL_GGRO} {
		value.command = command
		_, _, errno := unix.Syscall(unix.SYS_IOCTL, uintptr(fd), unix.SIOCETHTOOL, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&request))) //nolint:gosec // pointer-preserving native ifreq/ethtool_value layout.
		runtime.KeepAlive(&value)
		if errno != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("owned fragment ingress GRO command %#x: %v", command, errno)
		}
	}
	if value.data != 0 {
		t.Fatal("owned fragment ingress retained GRO")
	}
}

// Address visibility, even with NODAD, can precede ipv6_ifa_notify's local
// and peer routes. Require the full /128 tuple and all three native paths.
func nativeV6FragmentTupleReady(t *testing.T, route *netlink.Handle, link netlink.Link) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(nativeV6Wait)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	var addresses []netlink.Addr
	var routes []netlink.Route
	for {
		var err error
		addresses, err = route.AddrList(link, netlink.FAMILY_V6)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		routes, err = route.RouteListFiltered(netlink.FAMILY_V6,
			&netlink.Route{Table: unix.RT_TABLE_UNSPEC, LinkIndex: link.Attrs().Index},
			netlink.RT_FILTER_TABLE|netlink.RT_FILTER_OIF)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if nativeV6FragmentTuplePresent(t, addresses) {
			if nativeV6FragmentRoutePresent(routes, unix.RT_TABLE_LOCAL, unix.RTN_LOCAL, "2001:db8:6::1") {
				if nativeV6FragmentRoutePresent(routes, unix.RT_TABLE_MAIN, unix.RTN_UNICAST, "2001:db8:6::1") {
					if nativeV6FragmentRoutePresent(routes, unix.RT_TABLE_MAIN, unix.RTN_UNICAST, "2001:db8:6::2") {
						return
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("actual global /128 local/peer tuple and local/peer/connected routes did not publish: addresses=%+v routes=%+v", addresses, routes)
		}
		select {
		case <-t.Context().Done():
			t.Fatal(t.Context().Err())
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func nativeV6FragmentTuplePresent(t *testing.T, addresses []netlink.Addr) bool {
	t.Helper()
	for _, address := range addresses {
		if address.IPNet == nil {
			continue
		}
		if !address.IP.Equal(net.ParseIP("2001:db8:6::1")) {
			continue
		}
		ones, bits := address.Mask.Size()
		if bits != 128 {
			continue
		}
		if ones != 128 {
			continue
		}
		if address.Peer == nil {
			continue
		}
		if !address.Peer.IP.Equal(net.ParseIP("2001:db8:6::2")) {
			continue
		}
		ones, bits = address.Peer.Mask.Size()
		if bits != 128 {
			continue
		}
		if ones != 128 {
			continue
		}
		if address.Flags&unix.IFA_F_DADFAILED != 0 {
			t.Fatal("actual global IPv6 pair failed DAD")
		}
		if address.Flags&unix.IFA_F_TENTATIVE != 0 {
			continue
		}
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func nativeV6FragmentRoutePresent(routes []netlink.Route, table, kind int, address string) bool {
	for _, route := range routes {
		if route.Table != table {
			continue
		}
		if route.Type != kind {
			continue
		}
		if route.Dst == nil {
			continue
		}
		ones, bits := route.Dst.Mask.Size()
		if bits != 128 {
			continue
		}
		if ones != 128 {
			continue
		}
		if route.Dst.IP.Equal(net.ParseIP(address)) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
